item.title: Periodic review - temporary directional signs [12199], 5th November
item.description:
Our Ref- 12199 / EM-28 / Re-35478 We have housing development signs erected under your jurisdiction for the following housing development: Greenway Chase, off Shurdington Road in Leckhampton, Cheltenham, Gloucestershire. As part of the approval that is in place, you require us to review progress of the housing development to ensure the signs are still required. The developer has confirmed that the site has not complete and the signs are still required. • Current review date: 21-11-2026 • Next review date: 21-05-2027 • The total number of units on the development: 350 • The number of units complete: 80 Sold Your Fees If any fees are due in relation to this review, please forward an invoice or confirm the amount in any response and we will ensure payment is made as soon as possible. If a purchase order is required, please use the reference: 35478 Maintenance If you have instructed us to perform regular inspections of the signs as part of the approval, these will have been completed and we can provide additional detail on request. Regulations relating to the length of display of housing development signs Traffic Sign Regulations and General Directions 2016: Schedule 13 General Directions (11) The sign must not remain in place after the end of the period of six months that begins with the day the housing development to which the sign refers is complete. (complete is defined as when all properties are available for occupation) Additional Information If you require any additional information the detail will be in attachments to this email We will be in contact again on the next review date.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 2, Heathfield Road, Warden Hill, Cheltenham
